steps.label: Literature
steps.description: Find published MR evidence before starting an analysis.
steps.prompt: Does BMI causally affect type 2 diabetes? What does the MR literature say?

steps.label: Online GWAS
steps.description: Select online studies, review the plan, then calculate MR results and plots.
steps.prompt: Run MR for BMI and type 2 diabetes using online GWAS data. Show the results and plots.

steps.label: Local GWAS
steps.description: Use the two supplied native GWAS files as a separate analysis in this session.
steps.prompt: Use these two local GWAS files to run MR for BMI and type 2 diabetes.

steps.label: MR-APSS follow-up
steps.description: Reuse the local analysis context and suitable QC outputs for another method.
steps.prompt: Now use MR-APSS on the same local data and compare the results.
